title: Formation of the made field: bound, conserved densities and oscillator cells

key_results.statement: Class F, Ω the nondegenerate lowest eigenvector of $C_F$, first order in $g_s$: $\delta a(x,\lambda)=-\sum_{n\ne0}[\langle\Omega|A_x|n\rangle\langle n|B_0|\Omega\rangle g_\lambda(\omega_n)+\langle\Omega|B_0|n\rangle\langle n|A_x|\Omega\rangle\overline{g_\lambda(\omega_n)}]$ with $g_\lambda(\omega)=(1-e^{-i\omega\lambda})/\omega$; the static mark is the same with $g_\lambda\to1/\omega$.

Label form of (4.1) by translation covariance: $\delta a_{\mathbf q}(\lambda)$ pairs $A_{\mathbf q}$ with $B_{-\mathbf q}$ and carries the factor $1/|X_f|$; $\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}$ is the same with $g_\lambda\to1/\omega_n$.

Sum-rule weight $f_A(\mathbf q)=|X_f|^{-1}\langle\Omega|[A_{\mathbf q}^\dagger,[C_F,A_{\mathbf q}]]|\Omega\rangle\ge0$ and static self-response $\chi_Y(\mathbf q)\ge0$, fixed by $C_F$, the operator and Ω; for $B=A$, $\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}=-\chi_A(\mathbf q)$.

Item 1, class F, every $\mathbf q$, $L$ and $\lambda\ge0$: $|\delta a_{\mathbf q}(\lambda)|\le\min\{\lambda\sqrt{f_A\chi_B},2\sqrt{\chi_A\chi_B}\}$; for $B=A$, $|\delta a_{\mathbf q}(\lambda)/\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}|\le\lambda\sqrt{f_A/\chi_A}$; also for the nondegenerate highest eigenvector with $|f_A|$, $|\chi|$.

If $N=\sum_xA_x$ commutes with $C_F$ and the terms not commuting with the $A_x$ have finite range, then $0\le f_A(\mathbf q)\le c_A|\mathbf q|^2$ for every $L$, with $c_A=\frac12\sum_d|d|^2|F_A(d)|\le\|A_0\|\,\|[C_F,A_0]\|\sum_{0<|d|\le R_A}|d|^2$, $F_A(d)=\langle\Omega|[A_d,[C_F,A_0]]|\Omega\rangle$, fixed by $C_F$, $A$ and Ω (the bound by $C_F$ and $A$); also for the highest eigenvector with $|f_A|$; $c_A\le\bar c_A$ uniformly in $L$ if $R_A$, the number and norms of the terms of $C_F$ not commuting with $A_0$, and $\|A_0\|$ are bounded uniformly in $L$ (note (f)).

One label component, under (4.5), every source operator $B$: formation of the label component $\mathbf q$ to accuracy $\varepsilon$ needs $\lambda\ge(1-\varepsilon)|\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}|/(|\mathbf q|\sqrt{c_A\chi_B(\mathbf q)})$.

One label component, $B=A$ a conserved density with $|\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}|\ge s_0/|\mathbf q|^2$ ($|\mathbf q|\le q_1$): $\lambda_{\rm form}(\mathbf q;\varepsilon)\ge(1-\varepsilon)\sqrt{s_0/c_A}\,|\mathbf q|^{-2}$; also for the highest eigenvector.

Item 2, cubic torus, order $g_s\to0$, $L\to\infty$, $\ell\to\infty$: for a conserved density as in (4.5), any source with $\chi_B\le s_B/|\mathbf q|^2$ ($B=A$ included, there an assumption by note (f); several kinds of objects included), $c_A\le\bar c_A$ and $s_B\le\bar s_B$ uniformly in $L$ (note (f)), and a mark $\delta a_{\rm st}=s/|x|+o(|x|^{-1})$, $s\ne0$, in the limit $L\to\infty$: every $\lambda$ at which the made field at distance $\ell$ has formed in the mean (4.19) satisfies $\lambda\ge C_\Phi\ell^2(1+o(1))$, $C_\Phi>0$ independent of $L$; so $\lambda^\Phi_{\rm form}(\ell;\varepsilon)>\beta\ell$ for every $\beta$ and large $\ell$, also for formation at every place of the shell: no formation within a linear $\lambda$; also for the highest eigenvector; control (4.20).

One label component, $B\ne A$, under (4.5) with a long-range mark: formation within $\lambda\le\beta/|\mathbf q|$ requires $\chi_B(\mathbf q)\ge(1-\varepsilon)^2s_0^2/(\beta^2c_A|\mathbf q|^4)$; for $\chi_B\le s_B/|\mathbf q|^2$, $\lambda_{\rm form}(\mathbf q;\varepsilon)\ge(1-\varepsilon)s_0/(\sqrt{c_As_B}|\mathbf q|^2)$ for $|\mathbf q|\le q_1$; also for the highest eigenvector.

Oscillator class, $M\to\infty$ then $L\to\infty$, $A=B=q_x$: exact $\delta a_{\mathbf k}(\lambda)=-(1-\cos\Omega_{\mathbf k}\lambda)/\Omega_{\mathbf k}^2$, $\Omega_{\mathbf k}=\hat K(\mathbf k)^{1/2}$, and $u=\delta a-\delta a_{\rm st}=\int e^{i\mathbf k\cdot x}\cos(\Omega_{\mathbf k}\lambda)\Omega_{\mathbf k}^{-2}\,d^Dk/(2\pi)^D$.

Formation criterion along an axis: $|\Delta_D(\rho,\lambda)|\le\varepsilon$ for every $\lambda\ge\lambda_f$, with $\Delta_3$ the value ratio minus 1 ($D=3$) and $\Delta_1$ the difference ratio minus 1 ($D=1$); $\lambda_{\rm form}(\rho;\varepsilon)$, and the arrival $\lambda_{\rm arr}(\rho;\eta)$, the first $\lambda$ with $|\Delta_D+1|\ge\eta\rho^{-1/2}$.

Scaling limit $\rho\to\infty$ at fixed $w=c_0\lambda/\rho$, $\mu=m_h\rho/c_0$, $D=1$ and $D=3$: $\Delta_\infty=-1$ for $w<1$ and $\Delta_\infty=e^\mu-1-\mu e^\mu I_\mu(\mu\sqrt{w^2-1})$ for $w>1$, $I_\mu(Y)=\int_0^YJ_1(y)(y^2+\mu^2)^{-1/2}dy$.
$\Delta_\infty(w,\mu)=-1$ for $w<1$ and $|\Delta_\infty(w,\mu)|\le\mu e^\mu(1+\mu/2)$ for $w>1$.

Item 3, ring ($D=1$) and cubic torus ($D=3$), order $g_s\to0$, $M\to\infty$, $L\to\infty$, $\rho\to\infty$, then $\mu$ small; for every $K$ of the oscillator class with a single soft point (note (c)) whose part away from $\mathbf k=0$ has only folds, finitely many caustic values and nondegenerate critical points of $\Omega$ (note (d)); for every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ with $\mu e^\mu(1+\mu/2)<\varepsilon$: $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}(\rho;\varepsilon)/\rho\to1$, formation within a linear $\lambda$ at the speed $c_0$; lattice correction $O(\rho^{1/3})$ once the caustic wakes ($O(\rho^{-1/3})$) are below $\varepsilon-\mu e^\mu(1+\mu/2)$; the nearest-neighbour contract (caustic values none in $D=1$, $1+\sqrt2$ and $\sqrt2+\sqrt3$ in $D=3$) and the control (4.16) are members.

$c_0\le v_{\rm front}\le v_{\rm proj}\le v_{\rm slope}$ for every $K$ of the class; under the conditions of (4.14), $v_{\rm form}=c_0$, the made field is exponentially small ahead of $\rho/\lambda=v_{\rm proj}$, a precursor of relative size $O(\rho^{-1/3})$ precedes the formation, the first change arrives with $v_{\rm front}$ for the threshold $\eta\rho^{-1/2}$ when $v_{\rm front}=v_{\rm proj}$ (separable $\hat K_0$) and with $c_0$ for a fixed threshold; for the nearest-neighbour contract all four equal $\sqrt{\kappa_h}$.
Control of item 3: $\hat K_0=\sum_i(1-\cos k_i)(8-6\cos k_i)$ is a member of the class (notes (c), (d)) with $c_0=1<v_{\rm front}=v_{\rm proj}=v_{\rm slope}=2.475$.
Item 4, ring (or a lattice axis of the tori by assumption): $v_{\rm form}/v_{\max}=c_0/(k\tau)$; the two speeds are equal if and only if $c_0=k\tau$.

$\varepsilon=0.1$, finite-window values: control (4.16) $c_0\lambda^{\rm win}_{\rm form}/\rho\to1$ (1.018 at $\rho=512$, $D=1$; 1.082 at $\rho=48$, $D=3$, window $w\le1.57$), $v_{\rm front}\lambda_{\rm arr}/\rho\to1$; nearest neighbour 1.13 at $\rho=512$ ($D=1$), 3.1 to 4.2 in $D=3$ at $\rho\le48$ (caustic wakes of relative size $O(\rho^{-1/3})$); field of 06-ilang-source with the criterion of (8.10): $4\zeta_D\lambda^{\rm win}_{\rm form}/\rho^2\to1$ (1.076 at $\rho=32$, $D=1$; 1.108 at $\rho=64$, $D=3$).

Formation in the mean at distance $\ell$ (cubic torus): $|\sum_x\Phi(x/\ell)[\delta a(x,\lambda)-\delta a_{\rm st}(x)]|\le\varepsilon|\sum_x\Phi(x/\ell)\delta a_{\rm st}(x)|$ for every $\lambda\ge\lambda_f$, $\Phi\ge0$ smooth on the shell $1\le|y|\le2$; $\lambda^\Phi_{\rm form}(\ell;\varepsilon)$ the least $\lambda_f$; implied by formation at every place of the shell.

Control of item 2: oscillator cells, $D=3$, single soft point, $M\to\infty$, $L\to\infty$, $\ell\to\infty$ at fixed $\mu$: the mean deviation tends to $S_\infty(w,\mu)$ uniformly in $w=c_0\lambda/\ell$, $S_\infty=-1$ for $w<1$, $|S_\infty|\le2\mu e^{2\mu}(1+\mu)$ for $w>2$; for $2\mu e^{2\mu}(1+\mu)<\varepsilon<1$, $(1-\eta)\ell/c_0\le\lambda^\Phi_{\rm form}(\ell;\varepsilon)\le(2+\eta)\ell/c_0$ for large $\ell$.

open_issues: Item 2: (4.8) excludes linear formation in the mean on a shell and at every place of a shell; formation at a single place, or on a set that is not a positive fraction of a shell, is excluded only for the field of 06-ilang-source ((8.14) and the code).

Item 3: the front window |c_0 λ − ρ| = O(ρ^(1/3)) near the soft point rests on the scaling of the labels |k| = O(ρ^(−1/3)), not on note (d); the approach to v_form = c_0 is slow for the nearest neighbour and, at the distances computed in D = 3, still dominated by the caustic wakes.
Item 3, arrival: for non-separable members with v_front < v_proj, the decreasing-threshold arrival speed is only bracketed by v_front and v_proj.
Numerics: the computed formation values are finite-window values; the all-future statement rests on the uniform estimates of Step 6(b).
Item 1 for eigenvectors inside the spectrum: (4.4) holds with the sum of |ω_n| times the weights in place of f_A, but (4.5) does not apply.
Item 4 on the tori rests on the assumption that the coupling map runs along a lattice axis.

(8.15) as a special case: bound μ e^μ (1 + μ/2) of order m_Y ρ, remainder O(ρ^(−1/2)) for 1 < c < 2 below the first caustic value 1 + √2
